text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(It feels as if all of the blood coursing 
through me freezes to a stop.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Yet, my face always feels so hot. My legs 
quiver, and my whole body 
begins to 
throb. It's so deafening, and I just want it 
to stop...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Stop, stop, STOP!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —ber... Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober, is something the matter? They've 
already called your group to 
the starting 
gate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, s-sorry. I'll get going.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...You're looking a little pale, Dober. If 
you are not feeling well, 
then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, really.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. Don't worry about me. It's just a 
scrimmage race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: This is nothing for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is taking part in a scrimmage 
race with some of the 
other students 
today. Naturally, I've decided to 
accompany the chief 
trainer in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, but let's observe carefully. They're 
about to start now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My concern for her well-being will soon 
become justified.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clank!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
The inside! Head for the inside! Save your 
energy! Keep it up! Go for 
it, sis!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... gasp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's performance in this 
scrimmage race is unfortunately a 
far cry 
from the refined running I saw from her 
before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Don't look, don't look! Don't you even 
think about looking at the 
stands! I have 
to concentrate... Concentrate on the race, 
and then...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober finds herself unable to 
muster the kind of run she had 
achieved 
many times before, finishing in a lackluster 
eighth place.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Bell... It would seem that as a young child, 
she had a number of bad 
experiences that 
caused her to become quite nervous 
around others 
now.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she dedicated herself to her 
training while avoiding prying 
eyes. The 
Mejiro estate has plenty of open space 
that afforded her 
the opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She became so used to training only 
around her maids and family 
members... 
Now she struggles to compose herself in 
front of large 
crowds and especially men.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
So on a day like today, I understand why 
she wasn't able to show off 
the fruits of her 
training.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to enter these races, wanting to 
win as badly as she does... It 
must be so 
tough for her. But then again...

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text: She never gives up, that girl.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but ruminate on the chief 
trainer's words even days after 
the 
scrimmage races. One afternoon, while 
dining in the cafeteria at 
lunchtime...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is it okay if I sit here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's a bit of an overreaction... Maybe it 
figures, though, given how I 
don't think 
we've ever even made direct eye contact 
before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for suddenly approaching you 
like this, given we've never so 
much as 
made direct eye contact before. It's just 
that... I'm pretty shy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just know that I would face a repeat of 
that scrimmage race if I just 
let things be, 
however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just know that I would face a repeat of 
that scrimmage race if I just 
let things be, 
however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking that talking to you could 
be some good mental 
training for me! You 
can do that much as my assistant trainer, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I was hoping... maybe I could talk with 
you to help me build some 
mental 
fortitude. Would that be okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you, and sorry again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chief trainer's assessment of Mejiro 
Dober's resolve is certainly 
accurate—she 
really is trying her best. A conversation 
topic comes to 
me in an instant.
choice_data_list: Why did you set your sights on racing?

text_block_list.text:
The chief trainer's assessment of Mejiro 
Dober's resolve is certainly 
accurate—she 
really is trying her best. A conversation 
topic comes to 
me in an instant.
choice_data_list: Why did you set your sights on racing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Why start with that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? This is sudden. Um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This may... sound pretty cliché, but as a 
Mejiro, it was the world I 
grew up in close 
proximity to. It was easy to admire it, and I 
grew to 
want to succeed in it myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This may... sound pretty cliché, but as a 
Mejiro, it was the world I 
grew up in close 
proximity to. It was easy to admire it, and I 
grew to 
want to succeed in it myself.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ryan! Hey hey, Ryan! I want to race too! 
Let me race with you!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa, Dober? What's gotten into you 
all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to race! Just like you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I felt that I was born to run and win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For something that she has labeled as 
cliché, I cannot help but notice 
the sheer 
determination in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I can't even properly run in a race, 
though, then all this time and 
effort I've 
spent to realize my dream will have all 
been for naught. I 
have to become 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My trainer's been doing everything she can 
to support me. I simply 
must hurry up and 
show her I can win!
choice_data_list: You'll definitely be able to win.
You'll definitely be able to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What? How can you just say that so 
casually?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Mm... While I'm happy to hear you say 
that, I'm just still so weak...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't think... I've met anyone quite like 
you before. Trainer is the 
only other 
person to put as much faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, so after we're done eating, can you 
come with me for a bit? I 
want to sign up 
for my next scrimmage race. That's another 
thing you 
can do as an assistant trainer, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, after we're done eating, would you 
mind coming along with me? 
I'd like to 
sign up for my next scrimmage race, if you 
don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you what I'm truly capable of this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'd like to show everyone what 
I'm truly capable of. You 
included.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I've gotten just a touch 
closer with Mejiro Dober, 
even if our 
encounter was a little bit awkward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I've gotten just a touch 
closer with Mejiro Dober, 
even if our 
encounter was a little bit awkward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It would soon prove to be only the 
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It would soon prove to be only the 
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me, Trainer? Are we going to start 
the day's session—Trainer? 
Are you... 
sleeping?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...?! Trainer? Trainer?! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
S-somebody! Somebody please help, 
Trainer's—
